summary_en: Confirms the election of St Narcissus as principal patron of a new parish erected in the city of Girona (diocese of Girona, Spain); parish-level, so the level is recorded as 'other' and flagged for review.
excerpt: Gerundensis in Hispania, 22 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 516/71): confirmatur electio S. Narcissi, Patroni principalis novae paroeciae, quae in civitate Gerundensi erigenda est.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « a Praesentatione »

summary_en: Confirms the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Presentation, whose feast is celebrated on 2 February, as principal patron before God of the Prelature of Humahuaca (Argentina).
excerpt: Humahuacensis Praelaturae in Argentina, 19 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 3880/70): Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « a Praesentatione », cuius festum die 2 februarii celebratur, principalis apud Deum Patrona Praelaturae Humahuacensis confirmatur.

summary_en: Confirms the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of Mother of God as principal patron before God, and St Justus as secondary patron, of the whole diocese of San Justo (Argentina); two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Sancti Iusti in Argentina, 18 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 765/70): Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Matris Dei, principalis apud Deum Patrona et S. Iustus Patronus secundarius totius dioecesis confirmantur.

summary_en: Grants that the parish church of St Joseph the Worker in the city of Vasto (diocese of Vasto, Italy) be consecrated without consecration of the altar, and additionally that the solemnity of the anniversary of the consecration of that church may be celebrated on 31 October; a single-church item recorded for review.
excerpt: Vestanae in Italia, 26 ian. 1971 (Prot. n. 32/71): conceditur ut ecclesia paroecialis S. Iosepho Opifici dicata, in civitate Vestana, consecrari valeat, non obstante can. 1165 § 5 C.I.C., omissa consecratione altaris. Conceditur insuper ut sollemnitas anniversarii consecrationis eiusdem ecclesiae celebrari valeat die 31 octobris.

summary_en: Grants that, on the occasion of the eighth centenary of the dedication of the cathedral, the Mass and Office of the anniversary of the dedication may be celebrated throughout the diocese of Tournai (Belgium) on 9 May 1971, the fifth Sunday of Easter; a one-year concession recorded for review.
excerpt: Tornacensis, 28 dec. 1970 (Prot. n. 3866/70): conceditur ut, occasione celebrationis VIII centenarii dedicationis ecclesiae cathedralis, die 9 maii 1971, dominica quinta Paschae, celebrari possit, in tota dioecesi Tornacensi, Missa et Officium de anniversario dedicationis ecclesiae.

summary_en: Grants that the solemnity of the anniversary of the dedication of the church of « Notre-Dame Mère de la Sainte Espérence » at Mesnil-Saint-Loup (diocese of Troyes, France) may be transferred to the Monday after Pentecost; a single-church item recorded for review.
excerpt: Trecensis, 30 nov. 1970 (Prot. n. 3678/70): conceditur ut, sollemnitas anniversarii dedicationis ecclesiae v. d. « Notre-Dame Mère de la Sainte Espérence », loco « Mesnil-Saint-Loup », transferri possit in feriam secundam post Pentecosten.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Servorum Beatae Mariae Virginis

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Friar Servants of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Servites).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Servorum Beatae Mariae Virginis, 6 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 3485/70): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Ordinis.

summary_en: Grants that the feast of St Jeanne de Lestonnac, foundress of the Company of Mary Our Lady, may be celebrated on 15 May in that Society.
excerpt: Societas Mariae Dominae Nostrae, 11 ian. 1971 (Prot. n. 3823/70): conceditur ut festum S. Ioannae de Lestonnac, Fundatricis Societatis Mariae Dominae Nostrae, die 15 maii celebrari possit.

summary_en: Notification of the Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship (no protocol number printed) on the use of the new Missal, Liturgy of the Hours and Calendar: episcopal conferences are to fix the date on which the Calendarium Romanum of 14 February 1969 enters into force in their territory; those using a proper calendar keep it ad interim with grades adjusted to the universal norms; in 1972 the solemnity of St Joseph, falling on the fifth Sunday of Lent, is anticipated to Saturday 18 March (with Ordinaries able to allow the St Joseph Mass formulary at Saturday evening Masses); in 1973 the Nativity of St John the Baptist is kept on Sunday 24 June (or 23 June where Corpus Christi is transferred to that Sunday), and on Friday 29 June Sts Peter and Paul is celebrated with the Sacred Heart transferred to the following Sunday, while where Sts Peter and Paul is not of precept and is transferred to Sunday, the Sacred Heart is kept on 29 June and Sts Peter and Paul on 1 July.
excerpt: 7. Anno 1972, Sollemnitas S. Ioseph, dominica quinta in Quadragesima incidit. Proinde sabbato anticipatur, nempe die 18 martii. [...] 8. Anno 1973, ob occurrentiam quarundam sollemnitatum, Calendarium ordinatur sequenti modo: a) Die 24 iunii, dominica: IN NATIVITATE S. IOANNIS BAPTISTAE, Sollemnitas. [...] b) die 29 iunii, feria VI SS. PETRI ET PAULI, Apost., Sollemnitas. SS.mi CORDIS IESU, Sollemnitas.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St John of Ortega as patron of the Spanish professional association « Colegio Nacional de Aparejadores y Arquitectos Técnicos »; a patron of an association rather than of a territory or institute, recorded for review.
excerpt: Hispania, 26 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 1944/70): confirmatur electio S. Ioannis de Ortega Patroni Consociationis v. « Colegio Nacional de Aparejadores y Arquitectos Tecnicos ».

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Florian, martyr, as principal patron of the diocese of Linz (Austria), in place of St Maximilian.
excerpt: Linciensis in Austria, 21 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 926/71). confirmatur electio S. Floriani martyris, Patroni principalis dioecesis Linciensis, loco S. Maximiliani.

summary_en: Confirms the national calendar of Belgium together with the proper of Masses of Belgium.
excerpt: Belgium, 9 martii 1971 (Prot. n. 3257/70): confirmatur Calendarium nationale necnon proprium Missarum Belgii.

summary_en: Grants the archdiocese of Cape Town (South Africa) that the solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary « Our Lady of the Flight into Egypt » may be celebrated on the third Sunday in Ordinary Time, and that St Patrick be celebrated with the grade of feast.
excerpt: Civitas Capitis seu Capetownensis in Africa Meridionali, 4 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 837/71): conceditur ut sollemnitas B.M.V. v. d. « Our Lady of the Flight into Egypt » celebrari valeat in tertia dominica « per annum », et S. Patricius gradu festi.

summary_en: Grants the Philippines that the feast of the Holy Name of Jesus be celebrated on the third Sunday in Ordinary Time.
excerpt: Insulae Philippinae, 16 martii 1971 (Prot. n. 670/71): conceditur ut festum Sancti Nominis Iesu celebretur in tertia dominica « per annum ».

summary_en: Grants the diocese of Linz (Austria) that the feast of St Maximilian, bishop and martyr, be inserted in the diocesan calendar with the grade of memorial, and that the feast of St Severinus, abbot, be celebrated on 8 January.
excerpt: Linciensis in Austria, 21 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 895/71): conceditur ut festum S. Maximiliani, Episcopi et Martyris, gradu memoriae in Calendarium dioecesanum inseri valeat atque festum S. Severini Abbatis die 8 ianuarii celebretur.

summary_en: Grants the archdiocese of San Antonio (USA) that St Patrick may be celebrated on 17 March with the grade of feast.
excerpt: S. Antonius in Civitatibus Foederatis Americae Septentrionalis, 6 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 839/71): conceditur ut S. Patricius celebrari valeat die 17 martii gradu festi.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Society of Jesus.
excerpt: Societas Iesu, 26 martii 1971 (Prot. n. 651/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Societatis.

target.institute: Societas Parisiensis Missionum ad exteras gentes

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Paris Foreign Missions Society.
excerpt: Societas Parisiensis Missionum ad exteras gentes, 6 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 629/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Societatis.

summary_en: Grants the Congregation of the Sisters of Divine Providence that a votive Mass in honour of Blessed John Martin Moye may be celebrated on 4 May in the houses of the Congregation, provided no liturgical day listed in nn. 1-4 of the table of precedence occurs; a fixed-date votive Mass rather than a calendar inscription, recorded for review.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum a divina Providentia, 26 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 1055/71): conceditur ut die 4 mensis maii celebrari valeat in domibus Congregationis Missa votiva in honorem Beati Ioannis Martini Moye, dummodo non occurrat dies liturgicus in nn. 1-4 tabulae praecedentiae inscriptus

summary_en: Grants the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur that the solemnity of St Julie Billiart be celebrated on 13 May.
excerpt: Sorores Dominae Nostrae a « Namur », 13 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 538/71): conceditur ut sollemnitas S. Iuliae Billiart die 13 maii celebretur.
